findings.mechanism: Broad exception handler catches all errors and returns an empty list, swallowing the failure so the caller believes the customer has no orders (reference: silent failure description).
findings.remediation: Remove the blanket except block; let database exceptions propagate or translate them to an explicit error response (e.g., raise HTTPException 500) instead of returning [] on failure.
findings.arithmetic: The function always returns [] on any exception, so the HTTP layer will serialize this as a successful 200 response with an empty array. Therefore the observed http_status under a database‑unreachable condition is 200.
